نتماسك (form VI)
# نَتَمَاسَكُ (natamāsaku) /na.ta.maː.sa.ku/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of تَمَاسَكَ (tamāsaka)
# نَتَمَاسَكَ (natamāsaka) /na.ta.maː.sa.ka/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of تَمَاسَكَ (tamāsaka)
# نَتَمَاسَكْ (natamāsak) /na.ta.maː.sak/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of تَمَاسَكَ (tamāsaka)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
